name: cure-policy-guard
description: Refuses file writes that break a written Cure house rule (no cron in workflows, Vertex-only Gemini in Level5, no new AI vendors in minors' repos, no hard-coded credentials) unless the person overrides; every override is recorded. /policy-guard lists them.

askTimeoutSeconds.title: Override question timeout (seconds)
askTimeoutSeconds.description: How long the override question waits before the write is refused, so an unattended session or /loop never stalls. 5 to 600.
